children: [NASDAQ: EXLS], a global data and AI company, announced that it has been recognized as a “Horizon 3” provider in the HFS Research Horizons Customer Experience Service Providers 2026 report.

The report ranks 33 leading service providers on value proposition, execution and innovation, go-to-market strategy, and market impact. EXL earned Horizon 3, the report’s highest distinction, for combining AI, data, ecosystem partnerships, and outcome-led transformation to help clients unlock new business value and achieve measurable outcomes.

“EXL's strength is its continuity of offerings, spanning data engineering, decision intelligence, and customer experience (CX) execution,” said Melissa Fersht, executive research leader at HFS Research. “The combination of domain-led consulting, agentic AI, and proprietary IP, delivered through CX transformation programs with measurable gains, positions EXL as a leading CX ecosystem orchestrator.”

EXL earned this recognition for its ability to transform its clients' customer experience operations with data-driven, outcome-aligned processes and insights. The report highlights EXL’s proprietary CX Maturity Assessment Framework, which assesses clients’ current CX practices across data, analytics, AI, tech, and operations parameters to identify gaps in their current strategy and build executable roadmaps that help them move up the maturity curve.

“Customer experience is shifting toward agentic, AI-native, outcome-led delivery, making timely, mission-critical business insights more important than ever,” said Shashank Verma, senior vice president and global head of customer service transformation at EXL. “We’re proud to draw on our vast domain expertise to help our clients scale AI solutions to optimize their CX interactions and deliver real results.”

HFS highlighted EXL's AI-native CX transformation approach, which is grounded in data, domain expertise, and outcome-led delivery as well as its ability to integrate domain operations, data governance, AI engineering, and platform implementation across regulated industries. The report cited a large-scale healthcare transformation that generated substantial cost savings, increased containment, and improved customer experience metrics, which illustrates how EXL delivers measurable results in complex, highly regulated environments.
